instruction_changes.alternative: Keep native/model judgment and existing evaluation tools; no new evaluator, trial, orchestration layer or fixed task procedure.

change_reconciliation.requirement_reason: Makes intended measured behavior and invalid-trial handling explicit in the existing evaluation contract and status.
change_reconciliation.authority: User-required functional correction; this technical source record authenticates no approval and grants no provider, publication or installation authority.
change_reconciliation.checks: Current owner-bound runtime/worker/observer/guarded-client/send-lease cohort; focused caller/API, PM selection, coding-context-off, compressed recording/once-only transport controls; no native or provider launch.

framework_review.selection_reason: The existing trial-validity owner and actual runtime/recording dependency cohort must ship coherently; no second evaluator or transport is introduced.
framework_review.unaffected_reason: Other task methods, quality-first candidates, routing, memory, model defaults, runtime permissions and skill lifecycle retain their current source.
framework_review.checks: Only the validity paragraph is inserted into the current authoring contract; other bytes and newer guidance are preserved.

outcome_review.expected: Default interpretation rejects invalid or unexercised measurements and retains valid negative product outcomes; both projection calls receive the frozen plan.
outcome_review.observed: The composed caller accepts its required intervention clearance APIs and selected PM interpreter; the guarded observer retains decoded/encoded request pairs and final response, and the consumer validates them. Existing source-bound and once-only send guards are preserved.
outcome_review.evidence: Current owner-bound runtime/transport sources and prior independent component reviews; a previously reviewed path-component representation preserves the locator audit in 42 cases. Focused offline positive/negative controls are separate from retained historical trials, which are unchanged and excluded.
outcome_review.limitations: Source and deterministic offline checks only; normal release qualification, public authority, live SDK/model behavior and native activation remain separate.
